description: Read a workspace-relative UTF-8 text file. Plain {path} calls return the leading content prefix capped at 256 KiB. Supplying offset and/or limit returns a line-window with raw and numbered content. Returns structured errors including path_escape, not_found, is_directory, binary, validation, and io.
name: file_read

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to read.

offset.description: Optional 1-based starting line for a line-windowed read. When omitted, legacy prefix reads are preserved unless limit is present.

limit.description: Optional number of lines for a line-windowed read. Default 2000 when offset or limit is present; cap is 5000.
